correctness.rationale: The stand-alone verifier exhaustively enumerates all 65536 subsets (3054 nonempty faces), all 13584 face incidences, the 1514 acyclic Morse pairs and their exact signed cancellation pivots. Boundary matrices have one unit rank in degree 4 and a rank-four determinant -1 minor in degree 5, yielding torsion-free ranks 16 and 1; high-dimensional CW cancellations and π3=H3 give an actual wedge homotopy, not merely a homology guess. Original mod-2 boundary ranks are computed independently. An integral 92-term cycle and all 384 signed actions verify the H4 sign character; all 384 Lefschetz characters match the specified H3 representation. Finite exhaustive proof depends on the transparent executable code.

value.rationale: The first higher independence complex of the canonical four-cube (equivalently the periodic 4-by-4 grid) is a natural benchmark beyond the ordinary independence complex. Its nonpure facets, mixed-dimensional homotopy wedge, integral absence of torsion, and full 384-element representation character are not numerological consequences of older cardinality bounds, the known r=1 case, or homology alone. The explicit one-dimensional invariant subspace in degree 3 and sign degree-4 class motivate the precise equivariant invariant. No claim of broad or future dimension formula is needed.
